ChannelProductDescription.description: Description of the product for this channel listing specifically. This is an optional field that can be used to override the product description in the catalog.

ChannelProductName.description: Name of the product for this channel listing specifically. This is an optional field that can be used to override the product name in the catalog.

ChannelProductVariantDescription.description: Description of the product variant for this channel listing specifically. This is an optional field that can be used to override the description of the product variant in the catalog.

ChannelProductVariantName.description: Name of the product variant for this channel listing specifically. This is an optional field that can be used to override the name of the product variant in the catalog.

ChannelProductVariantPartial.description: Details about a variant of the product for this channel listing.

ExternalId.description: Associated ID within a system / platform outside of BC.

ListingId.description: The ID of the channel listing that has been created, returned, or updated. In a 422 error, you may receive a response that references the `group_id`. The `group_id` in the Invalid Listing ID example refers to the `listing_id`. Please use `listing_id` instead of `group_id` in the request payload.

ListingState.description: The state of the product assignment or channel listing.

ProductId.description: The ID of the product associated with this channel listing.

UpsertListingWithListingIdReq.description: Details about assigning a product to a specific channel.

VariantId.description: The ID of the product variant associated with this channel listing.

VariantState.description: The state of the channel listing variant.
